sentences.text: On 1.27, you must enable the CloudDualStackNodeIPs feature gate to pass a dual‑stack `--node-ip` value to the kubelet when using an external cloud provider.

citations.quote: When using an external cloud provider, you can pass a dual-stack `--node-ip` value to kubelet if you enable the `CloudDualStackNodeIPs` feature gate in both kubelet and the external cloud provider.

sentences.text: On 1.31, the documentation does not mention a feature gate for using a dual‑stack `--node-ip` with a cloud provider.

citations.quote: (The legacy built-in cloud providers do not support dual-stack `--node-ip`. )
